groups.defect: Per-user passkey/WebAuthn data (and possibly credential IDs) is now filled into login pages for a user identified only by a typed username, in both UsernamePasswordForm.challenge and PasswordForm.render. This tells unauthenticated visitors that the account exists and has passkeys. The fix is to gate this on re-authentication (USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH).
groups.rationale: Both report the same account and credential disclosure caused by the relaxed isConditionalPasskeysEnabled guard and propose the same fix. One points at UsernamePasswordForm and the other at PasswordForm.render, so the merged comment has to cover both locations.
